issue_request: FHIR-13158 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking for four Operations links on terminology-module.html to be corrected: CodeSystem $compose from #infer to #compose, ValueSet $expand from #lookup to #expand, ConceptMap $translate from #lookup to #translate, and ConceptMap $closure from #lookup to #closure.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 11892. In git, 9823e518a21e18e404922ec86056837c1c683a8b is '#13158 - fix broken links in terminology module page' and changes source/terminology-module.html exactly from the wrong #infer/#lookup anchors to the requested #compose/#expand/#translate/#closure anchors.
additional_context: source/terminology-module.html remains a build-scoped module page via source/hierarchy.xml. Later source history intentionally moved operation links to generated per-operation pages, renamed/remodeled the CodeSystem operation family, and removed the obsolete $closure and $find-matches operations for R6. Current source and the current build page list only active operation links and do not contain the FHIR-13158 bad anchors. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive conflicting community record; Zulip only surfaced tracker/svn bot notifications.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current specification is already correct after considering the original fix and later valid terminology-module refactors.
